Messages.Author: Ocean2862
Messages.Body:
To anyone.....Please tell me if there is a difference in these two Vampire
games. I bought several boxes of The Eternal Struggle several years ago, but
could never find the time to get into the game. This past weekend, I spent
over $100.00 on books for The Masquerade, thinking they were books for the sets
I had at home, which I later discovered they were two different names. I could
really use some help here, folks..... Thank you for your responses.
Ocea...@aol.com

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Vampire: The Eternal Struggle is a collectable card game
(CCG) from Wizards of the Coast that is "inspired by Vampire:
The Masquerade, the classic roleplaying game designed by
White Wolf." (a quote from the V:TES rulebook, appendix B).

The two games share a back story (that is, they're based in
the same "world" or "tradition"). But they are different games
in every other respect.
